## Problem

Suppliers and policyholders are experiencing delayed payments and status updates because of slow webhook retries and approval processes. This disrupts real-time claim processing and creates financial friction for downstream partners.

## Who is affected

- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reports delays with webhook retries on its supplier payments module, which affects how it processes claims and updates policyholders in real time [i:23d386fc82d6c342].
- Callowfield Auto Assurance says the issue has been holding up payments, and suppliers are starting to ask questions [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting says the delays are not just inconvenient but are holding up payments and supplier invoices too [i:45301fb117b39eed].

## Evidence

- Across 3 accounts, there are 3 mentions of this problem, arriving via 2 routes: 2 mentions from sales and 1 from support [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The affected accounts represent 1690000.0 GBP in total ARR: Orrinbury Fleet Insurance at 120000.0 GBP, Callowfield Auto Assurance at 1250000.0 GBP, and Holloway Reach Underwriting at 320000.0 GBP [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance raised the webhook retry delays on 2026-10-22, describing ongoing issues with real-time claim processing and policyholder updates [i:23d386fc82d6c342].
- Callowfield Auto Assurance raised the payment hold-up on 2026-10-28, noting that suppliers are starting to ask questions [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting raised the impact on payments and supplier invoices on 2026-10-17 [i:45301fb117b39eed].
- No renewals fall within the next 90 days: renewals_90d_n is 0, with the nearest renewal dates being 2027-02-16 for Orrinbury Fleet Insurance, 2027-03-31 for Callowfield Auto Assurance, and 2027-08-22 for Holloway Reach Underwriting [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].

## Why now

- The problem is being reported through both sales and support routes, with 2 mentions from sales and 1 from support across 3 accounts [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The affected accounts carry 1690000.0 GBP in total ARR, including Callowfield Auto Assurance at 1250000.0 GBP [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].
- With renewals_90d_n at 0, the nearest renewal is 2027-02-16 for Orrinbury Fleet Insurance, followed by 2027-03-31 for Callowfield Auto Assurance and 2027-08-22 for Holloway Reach Underwriting, giving a window to address the issue before renewal conversations [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The cited insights all point to the same direction: delayed payments and status updates are disrupting real-time claim processing and creating financial friction for downstream partners [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
</previous_draft>
